blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — A nationwide campaign seeking to enact an anti-political dynasty law through a People’s Initiative (PI) will roll out its Northern Mindanao leg on Wednesday, uniting various sectors to demand equal access to public service. The Dapat Isa Lang (D1L) Movement is set to hold its Region 10 launch and gathering tomorrow, from 1:30 p.m. to 4 p.m., at the Berchman’s Room of the Magis Canteen inside the Xavier University main campus here. The gathering will bring together representatives from the academe, civil society, faith-based organizations, youth and student groups, and professional and people’s organizations, said Nestor […]...
